artifacts.summary: Verified, per-call inventory (with suggested desc text) of vim.keymap.set calls missing a desc field: 40 genuine fixes across 11 files, plus 2 false positives (autopairs.lua, config/keymaps.lua) that the original review miscounted.

memory_candidates.content: When auditing vim.keymap.set calls for a missing `desc` field via textual/regex grep, watch for helper-function indirection: a file may define a local map(mode, key, cmd, options, description) wrapper that builds opts with desc = description internally, so the wrapper's own single vim.keymap.set(mode, key, cmd, opts) call body will look desc-less to a literal-token scan even though every real call site supplies a description. Verify by reading the helper body and a few call sites before flagging it as a defect.
